issue_context.title: Race condition in conformance test: should orphan RS created by deployment when deleteOptions.PropagationPolicy is Orphan
issue_context.body:
Hi,

first I have to mention I didn't saw this in Kubernetes CI, we're running the conformance tests on our internal platform and from time to time the test `should orphan RS created by deployment when deleteOptions.PropagationPolicy is Orphan` fails.


**Which test(s) are flaking**:
 `should orphan RS created by deployment when deleteOptions.PropagationPolicy is Orphan`

**Reason for failure**:
The test works like this:
* create deployment
* wait until replicaset is created
* delete deployment (with orphan)
* count if we have 0 deployments, 1 replicaset and 2 pods

In our environment it fails because from time to time we don't already have 2 pods. Imho this happens because the test doesn't wait until all Pods are created before deleting the Deployment

Proposed fix #92954
